firm_data.firm_description: Epstein Becker & Green, P.C. is a national law firm that focuses its resources on health care, life sciences, and workforce management solutions, coupled with powerful litigation strategies. They provide counsel in employment and labor law, health care and life sciences, and complex litigation.
notable_facts: Has a research center (KIN Center for Digital Innovation)
Has advised clients on AI systems for many years and has been involved in more than 200 AI-related health care and labor or employment projects.

email.subject: AI for Epstein Becker & Green, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Steven,

Your firm has completed over 200 AI-related projects across health care and employment law, with a dedicated team of data scientists, social scientists, and attorneys evaluating machine learning algorithms. That level of sophistication tells me you understand AI's potential, but also its real operational constraints.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
